newsitem.title: HONG KONG: APT leases transponder to China prov TV.
newsitem.headline: APT leases transponder to China prov TV.

text.p: APT Satellite Holdings Ltd said on Monday it was leasing an APSTAR-1A transponder to China Broadcasting Film Television Satellite Co Ltd (CBFTS).
It said the satellite would transmit television programmes for CBFTS' Guizhou television station to households in Guizhou province, across China, and to some parts of Asia outside China.
CBFTS is a subsidiary of China's Ministry of Radio, Film and Television.
APT Satellite Holdings said Guizhou was one of the first Chinese provinces to use satellite to transmit provincial television programmes.
